🔮 AstroTrader Pro™ — Today’s sky — October 23, 2026

Moon, in Pisces, holds a trine to Mercury, in Scorpio. Two water placements agreeing on the terms: what you already own finally finds the words to be counted.

Easier — Agreeing on a figure without feeling robbed by it.
Harder — Agreeing to something because agreeing feels pleasant.
Backdrop — Saturn and Uranus have just closed a sextile, new under everything else.

♈ ARIES
Mars, your ruler, crosses Leo untitled. Saturn sits inside your sign, and worth stops being an abstraction. Fire begins and is billed in the same gesture. Two weeks of this, and none of it is news.

♉ TAURUS
Venus, your ruler, is in detriment in Scorpio. Moon in Pisces opens a gap you have to step into. Earth that holds on, holding without strain. A week ago Venus was still held by Mars; that is finished.

♊ GEMINI
Mercury governs you, untitled in Scorpio. Moon squares you from Pisces, and the cost objects. Mutable air keeps two accounts open and pays both. Mercury has not been in Libra for four weeks.

♋ CANCER
Moon rules you from Pisces, untitled. Mercury trines you from Scorpio, meeting no resistance. Water moves first here, and first is enough. The hold Neptune had a week ago is not there any more.

♌ LEO
Sun rules you from Scorpio, untitled. From Scorpio, Mercury sets a figure against the wanting. Fire keeps its grip past the point it is worth. Since Sun crossed out of Libra, the question has changed.

♍ VIRGO
Mercury rules you and passes through Scorpio as a guest. From Pisces, Moon quotes your worth back at you. Earth bends, and each bend is invoiced. Venus let go of it two weeks ago.

♎ LIBRA
Venus rules you, exiled in Scorpio. Mars sextiles you from Leo: a door left ajar. Cardinal air: beginning costs almost nothing. Venus turned back three weeks ago; the review is still running.

♏ SCORPIO
Mars, your ruler, is only passing through Leo. Moon in Pisces sides with you before you have argued. Water keeps what it has, cheaply. Mars left Cancer four weeks ago, and the old terms went with it.

♐ SAGITTARIUS
Jupiter rules you from Leo, where nothing is owed to it. From Pisces, Moon cuts across the appetite. Mutable fire: keeping options is the expense. What pressed a week ago has cleared.

♑ CAPRICORN
Saturn rules you, fallen in Aries. Mercury sextiles you from Scorpio: an opening to be reached for. Earth that starts things, started cheaply. After two weeks of the same angle, the terms are familiar.

♒ AQUARIUS
Saturn, your ruler, falls in Aries. Mercury squares you from Scorpio, and something has to give way. Air holds on, and the holding is billed. The opposition to Sun that held two weeks ago has let go.

♓ PISCES
Jupiter, your ruler, moves through Leo unannounced. From Scorpio, Mercury makes it easy, which is not the same as right. Mutable water: two answers, and both are affordable. Nothing about it is a week old.
